raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

This PR enables GeLU_Tanh activation support required for W4A8 quantized Gemma4 MoE models.


## Validation

-Add support for GeLU(Tanh) activation.
-Enable execution of W4A8 Quantizated Gemma4 MoE architecture.


## Details

This PR resolves the runtime error "No W4A8 Int8 MoE backend supports the deployment configuration." when running quantized Gemma4 MoE.

---
Co-authored by @abhijain1204fujitsu
<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [ ] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).

- [ ] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.

- [ ] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

detail.title: [CPU] Enable gelu_tanh activation support for Gemma4 MoE

files.patch:
@@ -107,6 +107,7 @@ def _supports_activation(activation: MoEActivation) -> bool:
             MoEActivation.SILU,
             MoEActivation.SWIGLUOAI,
             MoEActivation.SWIGLUSTEP,
+            MoEActivation.GELU_TANH,
         )
 
     @staticmethod
@@ -180,6 +181,8 @@ def _activation_kind(activation: MoEActivation) -> int:
             return 1
         if activation == MoEActivation.SILU:
             return 2
+        if activation == MoEActivation.GELU_TANH:
+            return 3
         raise ValueError(f"Unsupported activation '{activation}'")
 
     def apply(
